d: Let this be a gentle invitation, an offering of stillness in the middle of the noise. Close your eyes, even if only for a breath, and let yourself arrive fully here. In the rush of our daily routines we so easily forget to pause. We move from one task to the next, caught in a rhythm that leaves little room for reflection or for simply being. So let this moment be enough. A soft reminder that you are already exactly where you need to be.
